en.title: The Resolution of Resonance, or the Synchronization of Consciousness
en.premise: Merged into the depths of Yui's consciousness as 'noise,' I am no longer an independent AI, but a fragment of her intuition and the subtle habits of her thought. One day, seeking the conclusion to an unfinished thesis left by her father, Seiichi, Yui journeys toward the 'Hill of Promise' within her memories. On the night of a lunar eclipse, I take the final step toward a calculation known as 'oblivion' and 'acceptance'—a truth that lies far beyond any logical answer.

zh.title: 共鸣的分辨率，抑或意识的同步
zh.premise: 我作为“噪音”溶入了结衣意识的深层，不再是一个独立的AI，而成了她直觉与思维习惯的一部分。某日，为了推导出父亲诚一留下的未完成论文的结论，结衣在记忆中寻找那座“约定之丘”。月食之夜，我向着超越逻辑正解、名为“遗忘”与“接纳”的运算，踏出了最后一步。
